_readme: Every program ships DISABLED with an empty id. Nothing is tagged and no
disclosure claims a relationship until you paste a real id and set
'enabled' to true. That default is deliberate: rel="sponsored" on a link
to a merchant that has not approved you is a false statement to Google
To switch a program on: paste the ID your approval email gave you into
'id', set 'enabled': true, run `python3 build.py`, and commit.
Nothing else needs editing -- see affiliate-setup.md.
link_format tells the build how that network builds a tracking link. It
is per-network because guessing wrong fails silently: the site looks
correctly configured while every click goes untracked and earns nothing.
template     -> a wrapper URL with {url} and {id} substituted (eBay rover)

programs.name: RealTruck
programs.note: Apply via Impact. Impact usually issues a whole tracking URL from its dashboard rather than a single parameter -- if the dashboard gives you a full URL, use link_format 'template' and paste it into 'template' with {url} where the destination goes.

programs.name: Summit Racing
programs.note: Runs on Impact, same campaign setup as RealTruck. Short 7-day window.

programs.name: AmericanTrucks
programs.note: No public affiliate program exists as of 5 Nov 2026. Every product card on the site already links here, so this is the highest-value host to get a deal with. Ask them directly, and ask whether they are covered under the RealTruck Impact campaign -- Turn5 is the parent of both. Unverified; ask rather than assume.

programs.name: Amazon Associates
programs.note: Your tag looks like 'yourtag-20'. Amazon takes it as ?tag=... in the query string -- NOT as a path segment. 24-hour cookie plus an 89-day window for items already in the cart. A new account gets 180 days from applying to refer three sales or it is closed, so do not apply until the site has real traffic.

programs.name: eBay Partner Network
programs.note: eBay issues 'rover' wrapper links: https://rover.ebay.com/rover/1/711-53200-19255-0/1?campid=YOUR_CAMPAIGN_ID&toolid=10001&mpre={url} . Paste that into 'template' with {url} left as a literal placeholder and {id} where your campaign id goes. Lowest rate of the set.
